lifecycle.subject: PermissionSubject derived from tool.ExtensionID + tool.ID (no global current user)
lifecycle.invocationBinding: Approval bound to exact Invocation ID via PermissionEvaluationRequest.InvocationID
lifecycle.duplicateApproval: Same Invocation ID → idempotent; Approvable once only
lifecycle.cancelBehavior: B43: awaiting_approval + cancel → cancelled; Pending Approval invalidated
lifecycle.timeoutBehavior: B44: awaiting_approval + timeout → timed_out; Pending Approval invalidated
lifecycle.lateApproval: Invocation terminal → late Approval ignored (no resurrection)
lifecycle.fullControl: ApprovalFullControl mode documented in PermissionDefinition → still passes PermissionBroker
